player_prompt.intro:
I ni Player {player_id} ye kɛlɛ sabanan na Spite and Malice. I lakana ni kɛ kɔnɔ i payoff pile la.

### Kɛlɛ Kɔkan:
- Lakana ni kɛ kɔnɔ i payoff pile la ka karti wɛrɛw kɛlɛ kɔnɔ.
- I bɛ se ka karti wɛrɛw jɔyɔ kɔfɛ:
  1. I **bolo** (i bɛ kɔnɔ kɛlɛ kɔfɛ 5 karti wɛrɛw).
  2. I **payoff pile la karti wɛrɛ**.
  3. I **discard pile la karti wɛrɛ**.

### Kɛlɛ Sirilan:
- I bɛ se ka karti wɛrɛ jɔyɔ kɔnɔ center pile kan o bɛ **kelen kɔnɔ** lajɛn kɔnɔ (center pile bɛ kɔnɔ Ace nɔfɛ ka kɔnɔ Queen; Kings bɛ wild - olu bɛ jɔyɔ kɔnɔ karti kamɛn, nka olu tɛ kɛlen kɔnɔ sirilan. O bɛ kɔnɔ 4 kɔfɛ, o bɛ kɔnɔ 5 nɔ, kɔnɔ 6 bɛ na).
- I bɛ se ka karti wɛrɛ jɔyɔ kɔnɔ, i bɛ **karti wɛrɛ kɛlɛ** discard pile kan ka kɛlɛ kɔfɛ.
- I center pile bɛ kɔnɔ Queen, a bɛ kɛlɛ kɔnɔ.
- Sirilan bɛ: A=1, 2=2, ..., 9=9, J=10, Q=11, K bɛ wild.

### Kɛlɛw:
1. **Karti wɛrɛ sɔrɔ**: Kɛlɛ kɔfɛ, karti wɛrɛ sɔrɔ ka kɛlɛ kɔfɛ 5 karti wɛrɛw. **[draw]** kɔfɛ kɛlɛ kɔnɔ.
2. **Karti wɛrɛ jɔyɔ**: Karti wɛrɛ jɔyɔ kɔfɛ, karti wɛrɛ nɔfɛ kɔnɔ center pile nɔfɛ kɔfɛ: **[play A♠ 0]** (karti wɛrɛ 'A♠' nɔfɛ kɔnɔ center pile '0' nɔfɛ).
3. **Karti wɛrɛ kɛlɛ**: I bɛ se ka karti wɛrɛ jɔyɔ kɔnɔ, karti wɛrɛ kɛlɛ discard pile kan ka kɛlɛ kɔfɛ. **[discard A♠ 1]** (karti wɛrɛ 'A♠' nɔfɛ kɔnɔ discard pile '1' nɔfɛ). I bɛ se ka karti wɛrɛ kɛlɛ payoff pile la, nka i bɛ se ka karti wɛrɛ kɛlɛ bolo la.

game_message.no_cards_left: Kariti wɛrɛ tɛ yen ka bɔ. I hakili to a la ko i bɛ se ka karitiw ta nin cogo ninnu fɛ: 1.I bolo 2.Karti min ye sanfɛla ye i ka juru donyɔrɔ kɔnɔ 3.Kaari min ye dugumali kɛ yɔrɔ dɔ la 4.N'i y'a sɔrɔ o ye kari ɲumanba ye, n'o ye kadi jugu ye, ni wari bɔra a tigi la 5.Ni warablen tun lo, nka sisan u b'a dɔn k'u ma foyi ɲɛ fɔlɔ 6.A filɛ sa!

invalid_move.wrong_format: Jatebla min tɛ waleya. Ɲinɛnbaa {player_id} ma jabi ni jatebɔ ɲuman ye ka sɔrɔ a bɛ kɛ sigilanw na.

invalid_move.discard_from_payoff: Jate {player_id} ye a ɲini ka kadi bila bɔli la.
invalid_move.discard_not_in_hand: Karamɔgɔ {player_id} y'a ɲini ka kariti fili min tɛ a bolo.

game_action.you_discarded: I ma {card} doni discard pile {index}, ko siɛnna i tun ye i ka kɛlɛ i ka tɔgɔ. A be se ka kɛ i ka tɔgɔ kɔnɔ. Jokelani {next_player_id} bɛ i tɔgɔ.
game_action.opponent_discarded: Player {player_id} discarded {card} to discard pile {index}, which also means they finished their turn. No further actions of Player {player_id} is considered for this turn. Player {next_player_id}, you will go next. Please enter your action in the format [action card center_index].

outcome.deadlock_player_1: Kɛlɛ kɔnɔ bɛ kɔnɔ! Player 1 lakana {player_1_payoff} karti wɛrɛw kɔnɔ vs Player 0 {player_0_payoff} karti wɛrɛw.
outcome.deadlock_tie: Kɛlɛ kɔnɔ bɛ kɔnɔ ka tie! Player wɔɔrɔ bɛ {player_0_payoff} karti wɛrɛw kɔnɔ. Player {current_player} lakana kɔfɛ.
